name: Demo G8: Move Manual Balancing Damper Redline
description: Exercise a move-like redline operation for a modeled MEP accessory using the family-instance evidence contract: create a disposable manual balancing damper/accessory, prove its requested type and initial location, move it with native dry-run/apply evidence, prove the model-space delta, write a deterministic visual gate, and clean it up.
setup_instructions: Open a disposable Revit model or a model that can be closed without saving.
Use a view, level, and MEP accessory family/type that can be safely placed, moved, and deleted.

For the first live smoke, use a low-risk level-hosted or non-hosted damper/accessory symbol. Host-aware duct accessory placement remains a later live hardening step if the active damper family requires duct hosting.
success_criteria: A disposable MEP accessory family instance id is created in the model.
The native create result returns family/type/name evidence matching the requested manual balancing damper/accessory symbol.
The created accessory id is visible in the pre-move visible-element inventory with a model-space point.
Native move dry-run and apply evidence include the created accessory id.
The post-move visible-element inventory contains the same id at the requested model-space delta.
A deterministic move visual gate artifact passes using before/after capture evidence.
The moved accessory is cleaned up with native dry-run and applied delete effect evidence.
failure_criteria: The accessory is not created or is created as a different requested type.
The before/after visible-element inventory cannot prove the requested movement vector.
Move dry-run or apply omits the accessory id from effect evidence.
The move visual gate artifact is missing or fails.
Cleanup delete dry-run/apply omits the accessory id from effect evidence.
grader_notes: This task extends MEP accessory benchmark coverage from add/delete into move-like damper redlines.
Do not count requestedIds-only move or cleanup responses as evidence; move/delete must return ids, movedIds, deletedIds, or impactedIds as appropriate.
